response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web developer with strong general software engineering skills, but he does not meet several hard requirements for this role: there is no indication of native-level Japanese proficiency (a strict requirement), no Linux kernel investigation or modification experience, and only brief C/C++ exposure (one ~6-month role at National Instruments). His career centers on web platforms (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang), not embedded networking firmware, and he shows no background in L2/L3 switching, MACsec, 802.1X, or related security technologies.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software development experience across web, mobile, desktop, and some embedded contexts
Strong Linux, Docker, and CI/CD tooling experience with a testing/quality-focused engineering mindset
Some low-level systems exposure (C/C++ at National Instruments, low-latency DLang services, audio hardware thesis project)
concerns: No evidence of Japanese language proficiency, which is a mandatory native-level requirement
Lacks required embedded networking and security domain experience (LAN switches, MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP/NETCONF)
Minimal C-for-UNIX experience and no Linux kernel source investigation or modification background
